summary: Verified all 8 bug fixes for content de-duplication and cross-page consistency on the Dubai Vize Online site. Backend /api/visa-types returns 8 active types, each with exactly 5 features ending in 'Uzman danışman desteği' and 'Dijital vize teslimi'. Guide payload no longer contains photo_rules/process_steps and generic FAQs are stripped. Frontend: all 8 visa cards on /vize-tipleri (4 tabs) follow the identical 30-day pattern; prices are consistent across /vize-tipleri, /dubai-vizesi/60-gun-tek-giris and home showcase (60_single=9.880 ₺, 30_child=2.470 ₺). Guide page has no old 4-step grid, no photo rules block, has compact doc rows, guide-documents-link, tips section with guide-process-link, and guide-faq-all-link. /sss and footer use single-source hours ('Hafta içi 09:00 - 19:00 · Cumartesi 10:00 - 16:00'); no 09:00-18:00 found. /hakkimizda about-stat-applications=5.678+ and about-stat-recommend=%96; no '4.500+' anywhere. Express wording is '~8 mesai saati' everywhere; no '24 saat' or '20 saat' found on home, /vize-tipleri or guide pages. Home page regression: all restructured sections present and tracking form navigates to /takip?kod=ABC12345. Guide apply buttons and CTA correctly link to /basvuru?vize=<id>. No mocked test data (Test Turizm, test@vizeatlas, 0850 123) found in code or rendered pages.
